12.t: Working with data: reading a graph
q: How tall was the plant on day 8?
How much did the plant grow between day 6 and day 10?
Describe how the growth rate changes over the 14 days.
Slow at first (1 cm by day 2), fastest between days 4 and 10 (about 2.5 to 3 cm a day), then slower again by days 12 to 14.
Predict the height on day 16 and explain your prediction using the shape of the graph.
About 27 cm: the curve is levelling off, growing only 2 cm between days 12 and 14, so growth will probably slow further.
